input.domain: Both explicitly present decoded valid UTF-8 Text,0..1024 UTF-8 bytes inclusive. Missing,wrong-type,malformed UTF-8,lone surrogate escapes or unsupported length must be refused before native execution. Header-invalid in-domain strings remain diagnostic inputs.
input.external_schema: exactly one JSON object with exactly two unique string fields name and value; raw bytes<=16384

semantics.name: unchanged decoded name Text; preserves UTF-8 bytes rather than original JSON escape spelling
semantics.name_valid: actual pinned httpguts.ValidHeaderFieldName(name) within bounded valid UTF-8 domain
semantics.value_valid: actual pinned httpguts.ValidHeaderFieldValue(value) within bounded valid UTF-8 domain
semantics.name_empty: decoded name UTF-8 byte length is zero
semantics.name_has_uppercase: any original name byte is ASCII A through Z, including after an earlier invalid byte
semantics.value_has_obs_text: any original value byte is at least 128, including after an earlier invalid byte
semantics.value_edge_whitespace: nonempty value begins or ends with SP(32) or HTAB(9)
semantics.name_invalid_offset: zero-based UTF-8 byte offset of first non-token name byte, otherwise -1; empty name remains -1 although invalid
semantics.name_invalid_octet: first non-token name byte value 0..255, otherwise -1
semantics.value_invalid_offset: zero-based UTF-8 byte offset of first value byte below32 except HTAB, or DEL(127), otherwise -1
semantics.value_invalid_octet: first forbidden value byte value 0..255, otherwise -1

kernels.output: Boolean; nonempty ASCII HTTP token; uppercase allowed
Boolean; empty allowed, rejects C0 except HTAB and DEL, permits obs-text and edge SP/HTAB

scope: Pure deterministic diagnostics require no per-case human approval and perform no effects.
Input preprocessing establishes the bounded Text domain, not header validity or request authority.
No trimming,normalization,lowercasing,raw JSON escape preservation,HTTP2,field occurrence policy,HTTP framing,authorization or sending.
Fixed finite inputs do not cover all UTF-8 strings,all positions or arbitrary invalid UTF-8.
Exact typed12 fields/source/producer/raw saved outer-parent checks do not establish independent inner typed canonical parent digest acceptance; NOT_CHECKED remains explicit.
Fresh current public native execution,saved replay and CI are required; private pilot evidence is not current public acceptance.
